name: Diwali
description: Festival of lights symbolizing the victory of light over darkness.
attire: Traditional Indian attire such as Kurta, Saree, Lehenga

name: Dussehra
description: Festival celebrating the victory of Lord Rama over Ravana, marked by Ramlila plays and burning of effigies.

name: Holi
description: Festival of colors celebrating the arrival of spring and the victory of good over evil.
attire: White clothes like Kurta-Pajama or Saree

name: Janmashtami
description: Birth of Lord Krishna celebrated with fasting, devotional singing, Dahi-Handi, and midnight rituals.

name: Christmas
description: Celebration of the birth of Jesus Christ with decorations, prayers and festive joy.

name: Ganesh Chaturthi
description: Celebration of Lord Ganesha’s birth with grand idol installations and processions.

name: Makar Sankranti
description: Harvest festival marking the sun’s transition into Capricorn, famous for kite flying.

name: Navratri
description: Nine-night festival celebrating Goddess Durga with Garba and Dandiya nights.
attire: Chaniya Choli for women, Kurta-Dhoti for men

name: Pongal
description: Harvest festival thanking the Sun God for agricultural abundance.
attire: Veshti for men, Saree for women

name: Baisakhi
description: Harvest festival marking the Punjabi New Year and Sikh community celebrations.

name: Durga Puja
description: Celebration of Goddess Durga's victory over Mahishasura with elaborate pandals and rituals.
attire: Traditional Bengali attire like Saree and Dhoti

name: Eid-ul-Fitr
description: Celebrates the end of Ramadan with prayers, feasts, gifts and charity.
attire: Traditional attire such as Kurta, Salwar Kameez

name: Lohri
description: Winter harvest festival celebrated with bonfires, traditional songs, and dance.
attire: Punjabi Kurta, Salwar Kameez, Phulkari Dupatta

name: Rath Yatra
description: Grand chariot festival of Lord Jagannath celebrated in Puri with massive crowds.

name: Onam

name: Hornbill Festival
description: Celebration of Naga culture with folk dances, crafts, food, and tribal performances.

description: Cultural festival representing Assamese New Year with dance, music, and feasts.

name: Gudi Padwa

name: Chhath Puja
description: Worship of the Sun God with offerings, fasting, and riverside rituals.

name: Hemis Festival
description: Buddhist monastery festival featuring masked dances and spiritual ceremonies.

name: Raksha Bandhan

description: Vibrant carnival with parades, costumes, samba music, and street celebrations.

name: Chapchar Kut
description: Spring festival celebrated with bamboo dance, songs, and vibrant cultural shows.

name: Wangala Festival
description: 100-drum festival of the Garo tribe celebrating harvest and thanking the Sun God.

name: Ooty Summer Festival

name: Ram Navami
description: Celebration of the birth of Lord Rama with fasting, prayers, and processions.

name: Bhogi

name: Boat Race Festival (Nehru Trophy)

name: Losar

name: Bhandara Festival
